stiffness.label: Stiffness (flat-part proxy)
stiffness.explain: Bending stiffness of the printed material per layer, relative to a solid part of the same height. Beam theory with perfect layer bonding: compare variants of one flat part, not different parts.

near_cap_s.label: Time at the flow cap
near_cap_s.explain: Printing time at 95% or more of the filament's max volumetric speed. Less is more headroom against under-extrusion.

knobs.label: Bridge speed
knobs.explain: Speed of bridges over air or sparse infill. Faster bridges can sag; check a test print.

knobs.label: Top shell layers
knobs.explain: Solid layers under the top surface. Fewer is faster and lighter; too few can show infill through the top.
knobs.note: Bambu keeps at least top_shell_thickness (1 mm by default), so it is set to 0 whenever this changes.

knobs.label: Bottom shell layers
knobs.explain: Solid layers above the bed-side surface.
knobs.note: bottom_shell_thickness is set to 0 whenever this changes, for the same reason as the top shells.

knobs.label: Infill density
knobs.explain: How much plastic fills the inside.

knobs.label: Infill pattern
knobs.explain: Shape of the inside fill. Gyroid has no crossings on one layer; grid crosses itself.

knobs.label: Speed on 50–75% overhangs
knobs.explain: Thin bridged features, such as fine grid bars, often print at this speed. Faster can droop; check a test print.

knobs.label: Outer wall speed
knobs.explain: The visible surface. Slower usually looks better.

knobs.label: Solid infill speed
knobs.explain: Often capped by the filament's flow; check the Flow view.

knobs.label: Sparse infill speed
knobs.explain: Often capped by the filament's flow; check the Flow view.

knobs.label: Layer height
knobs.explain: Thicker layers print faster and show more steps on slopes and fillets.
knobs.off_by_default: Changes how slopes and curves look; turn it on if that's fine for this part.

knobs.label: Filament flow cap
knobs.explain: The most plastic per second the slicer will ask for. Raise it only after a flow calibration: above the hotend's real limit it under-extrudes.
knobs.off_by_default: Raise the flow cap only after a flow calibration of this filament.
